details.summary:
Nestled in the Western Ghats of Karnataka, Coorg (Kodagu) is known for its mist-covered hills, coffee estates, lush forests and distinctive Kodava culture.

This Coorg 2 Nights / 3 Days package is designed for travellers who want to experience the region's highlights without rushing through the destination.

Your holiday begins with a comfortable transfer from Bengaluru Airport to Coorg, taking you through the scenic landscapes of Karnataka. Once you arrive in Coorg, explore its famous coffee plantations, visit a local honey or spice farm and enjoy the refreshing atmosphere of Abbey Falls.

As the day winds down, head to Raja's Seat, one of Madikeri's most popular viewpoints, for panoramic views of the misty Coorg valley.

The second day takes you deeper into Coorg's natural, cultural and historical attractions. Visit Talacauvery, traditionally regarded as the origin of the River Cauvery, followed by Bhagamandala, where the Cauvery and its tributaries meet. Later, explore Madikeri's historic landmarks before enjoying some free time for shopping and exploring the local town.

With comfortable accommodation, daily breakfast, private transfers and sightseeing included, this package offers an easy way to experience the highlights of Coorg, Karnataka.

activities.title: Bengaluru Airport pickup
activities.description:
Arrive at Kempegowda International Airport, Bengaluru, where your private vehicle and experienced driver will be waiting for you.

Begin your scenic journey towards Coorg.

activities.title: Coffee, honey & spice plantations
activities.description:
Upon reaching the Coorg region, experience the lush surroundings and famous coffee-growing landscapes.

Depending on the operational schedule and arrival time, visit:

• Coffee plantations • Honey farms • Cardamom/spice plantations

Discover how some of Coorg's most popular agricultural products are grown and processed.

activities.title: Abbey Falls
activities.description:
Continue to Abbey Falls, one of Coorg's most popular natural attractions.

Enjoy the walk through the greenery and take in the sights and sounds of the cascading waterfall.

activities.title: Raja’s Seat
activities.description:
Later, visit Raja's Seat, a scenic viewpoint overlooking the Coorg valley.

Enjoy the beautiful landscape and, if weather conditions are favourable, watch the sunset over the surrounding hills.

activities.title: Hotel check-in & leisure
activities.description:
Proceed to your hotel in Madikeri/Coorg.

Check in, relax and enjoy the rest of the evening at leisure.

Overnight stay in Coorg.

activities.title: Breakfast at the hotel
activities.description: Start your day with breakfast at the hotel.

activities.title: Talacauvery
activities.description:
Proceed towards Talacauvery, located in the Brahmagiri Hills.

Traditionally regarded as the origin of the River Cauvery, this scenic destination offers beautiful views of the surrounding Western Ghats.

activities.title: Bhagamandala
activities.description:
Continue to Bhagamandala, an important pilgrimage destination associated with the meeting of the Cauvery and its tributaries.

Explore the area and experience its peaceful atmosphere.

activities.title: Madikeri Fort & Omkareshwara Temple
activities.description:
Return towards Madikeri and explore some of the town's prominent attractions.

Visit:

• Madikeri Fort • Omkareshwara Temple

Discover the history and architecture of these important landmarks.

activities.title: Shopping in Madikeri
activities.description:
Spend the evening exploring Madikeri's local markets and shops.

You can shop for Coorg coffee, spices, honey, chocolates and other regional products.

Return to the hotel.

Overnight stay in Coorg.

activities.title: Breakfast & hotel check-out
activities.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from the hotel.

activities.title: Return journey to Bengaluru
activities.description:
Your private vehicle will take you from Coorg towards Bengaluru.

Relax and enjoy the changing landscapes as you make your way back to the city.

activities.title: Bengaluru Airport
activities.description:
Arrive at Bengaluru Airport for your onward journey.

Your 2 Nights / 3 Days Coorg holiday comes to an end with wonderful memories of Karnataka's coffee country.

Trip Ends.

pageSections.tagline: Discover Coffee Plantations, Waterfalls & the Misty Hills of Coorg
pageSections.introduction:
Escape to the lush hills of Coorg (Kodagu) with this carefully planned 2 Nights / 3 Days Coorg holiday package. From aromatic coffee plantations and cascading waterfalls to historic landmarks and breathtaking valley views, this short getaway brings together the best of Coorg in a relaxed itinerary.

Your journey includes private AC transportation, hotel accommodation, breakfast and sightseeing, making it an ideal choice for couples, families and small groups looking for a convenient Coorg trip from Bangalore.

items.title: How many days are enough for a Coorg trip?
items.body: A 2 Nights / 3 Days Coorg trip is ideal for covering the major attractions around Madikeri and experiencing the region without making the itinerary excessively rushed.

items.title: What is included in this Coorg package?
items.body: The package includes 2 nights' accommodation, daily breakfast, private AC transportation, Bengaluru Airport transfers, sightseeing and an experienced driver, as specified in the itinerary.

items.title: Is this a Coorg package from Bangalore?
items.body: Yes. The package starts with pickup from Bengaluru Airport and includes transportation to Coorg, local sightseeing and return transfer to Bengaluru Airport.

items.title: Can I start the trip from Bangalore city instead of the airport?
items.body: The standard itinerary is based on Bengaluru Airport pickup and drop. If you require pickup from another location in Bangalore, availability and additional charges can be checked while planning your trip.

items.title: What type of vehicle is included?
items.body: A private AC sedan with seating for up to 4 passengers is included in the package.

items.title: Is breakfast included?
items.body: Yes. Breakfast is included during your 2-night stay at the hotel.

items.title: Is lunch and dinner included?
items.body: No. Lunch and dinner are not included unless specifically mentioned in your booking.

items.title: Which places are covered in the Coorg itinerary?
items.body:
The itinerary includes:

• Coffee plantations • Honey/spice plantations • Abbey Falls • Raja's Seat • Talacauvery • Bhagamandala • Madikeri Fort • Omkareshwara Temple • Madikeri local shopping

items.title: Is Abbey Falls included?
items.body: Yes. Abbey Falls is included as part of the Day 1 sightseeing itinerary.

items.title: Is Talacauvery included?
items.body: Yes. Talacauvery and Bhagamandala are covered during the Day 2 Coorg sightseeing tour.

items.title: Is this Coorg package suitable for families?
items.body: Yes. The itinerary is suitable for families, couples, friends and small groups looking for a comfortable Coorg holiday.

items.title: Is this Coorg trip suitable for couples?
items.body: Absolutely. The combination of scenic viewpoints, coffee plantations, waterfalls and comfortable accommodation makes this a good option for a Coorg couple trip.

items.title: What is the best time to visit Coorg?
items.body: Coorg can be visited throughout the year. October to March is generally popular for pleasant weather and sightseeing, while the monsoon months offer lush greenery and dramatic waterfalls.

items.title: Can the itinerary be customised?
items.body: Yes. Depending on availability, you can request changes to hotels, sightseeing, vehicle type, trip duration and other travel requirements.

items.title: Are attraction entry tickets included?
items.body: Entry tickets are not included unless specifically mentioned under the package inclusions.

items.title: What happens if the flight is delayed?
items.body: If your arrival flight is delayed, the pickup and sightseeing schedule may need to be adjusted based on the available time. Please inform the CompareMyTrip team as soon as possible if your flight schedule changes.

items.title: Can the hotel be changed?
items.body: Yes, subject to availability. If the confirmed hotel is unavailable, a similar-category hotel may be offered.

items.title: Is the vehicle available for the entire trip?
items.body: Yes. The private vehicle is provided for transfers and sightseeing according to the agreed itinerary.
